DIAGNOSIS READY: Malignant Ovarian Neoplasm with Malignant Ascites (Ovarian Cancer)

The patient is a 40-year-old nulliparous woman with a large ovarian mass and acute symptoms of ascites and shortness of breath. To confirm the diagnosis and stage the disease, I need to see the ultrasound images of the abdomen and pelvis, and request results for a CA-125 level and a CT scan of the chest/abdomen/pelvis.
